title: Ex-BARMM official to appear before PDEA on Nov. 5 over Laos drug probe

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former Bangsamoro parliament member Edrieza Hadji Nasser Rimbang, whom authorities have identified as the alleged financier of the Laos drug shipment, is expected to appear before the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) on Nov. 5. PDEA spokesperson Joseph Frederick Calulut said Rimbang’s lawyers had committed to bringing him to the agency’s office to submit a sworn statement as part of the investigation. “The lawyers of Sultan Rimbang came to our office the other day and they committed to present him sa opisina natin (to our office) on Nov. 5,” Calulut told reporters in a phone interview.
